purpose: Verify repeatable finite training after isolating the AdamW update on CPU, and compare a frozen-base KL penalty and a drug-only token loss weighting against matched CE.

diagnostic.mps_fp16_original: 8 finite forward losses; AdamW step 2 called; guard refused nonfinite LoRA weights; 0 checkpoints.
diagnostic.cpu_shadow_adamw_mps_fp16: 3 guarded CPU optimizer updates and 13 finite forwards; no stored checkpoint.
diagnostic.interpretation: The explicit CPU optimizer route avoids the reproduced failure at this horizon. The precise MPS operation or underlying numerical mechanism is unproven. The conditional FP32 fallback was not needed.

matching.base: Same verified original Whisper Turbo checkpoint; zero-effect LoRA, fixed rank and targets.

drug_weighting: Only source-verified B-drug/I-drug entities in the fixed train rows; discard orphan continuation and entities with digits, units, number words or negation markers. Require identical tokenizer IDs and valid offsets. Only subtokens fully inside a valid entity (ignoring whitespace). No extra weight for force/dose tags, prompt, forced prefix, EOS, or padding. No evaluation reference or lexicon in generation.

generation.reference_audio: Published simulated prescriptions in PxCorpus v4 under CC BY 4.0. The 96 clips remain development, not independent held-out clinical audio.
generation.comparisons: Base and each arm paired on the same PCM; also compare KL and drug-weighted CE to the matched CE arm on the same clips.
generation.synthetic_negation_supplement: Separate fixed fictitious French panel, if available with local installed voice. All test text, PCM and applicable positive/negative controls must be frozen before any generation for this panel. Report TTS limitations and actual coverage separately; without audio, text guards only. Zero paired regression on covered critical fields including negation and laterality; no safety claim if there is no qualified speech sample.
generation.reserve: No benchmark generation, tuning or scoring on the 85 WAV reserve. The source archive is still validated for provenance and split exclusion.

decisions.each_window: Zero new scored critical failures versus the base and versus matched CE; report losses, gains, denominators, clips affected, and manual review of losses. EOS present for all paired clips. Both cumulative and median generation seconds at most 110% of the paired base. Note MPS benchmarking order and avoid claiming Windows latency.
decisions.additional64: Strictly more correctly recognised drug spans and fewer word errors than both base and matched CE, in addition to the zero-regression gates.
decisions.base_replay: Require identical base text on every repeated clip before drawing between-arm conclusions.
decisions.interruption: Record failed or incomplete arms, no weights admitted via training loss alone, no change to coefficient/seed/train rows/checkpoints after looking at outputs.
decisions.adoption: Research screening only. No quantised/exported model, product weight substitution, new-voice qualification or clinical claim. A candidate passing needs fixed tests on independent voices and the intended runtime.
